content:
Apple has released new firmware for AirPods Pro 3 and other select AirPods models, adding support for the latest iOS 27 features.

The brand-new AirPods firmware launches alongside iOS 27, supporting the newest features

Apple today officially released iOS 27 for iPhone, and the company has also begun pushing out new firmware to AirPods that supports the latest features in this update.

The latest AirPods firmware version is 9A348.

The new firmware applies to the following designated models:

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods Pro 2
  • AirPods Max 2
  • AirPods 4

AirPods 5 will support the new firmware when it goes on sale later this week.

Apple's new firmware adds compatibility and support for the latest AirPods features in iOS 27.

  • Custom EQ
  • Siri AI compatible with iPhone
  • Precision Finding via Apple Watch
  • GymKit support
  • Redesigned AirPods settings

About half of the new features are exclusive to AirPods Pro 3, while the remaining features extend to more models.

Apple does not provide a way to manually trigger an AirPods firmware update, but they have published a tutorial explaining how to ensure the update can be automatically installed in the background.

Have you installed the new AirPods firmware? What are your thoughts on the new features in iOS 27? Feel free to share in the comments section.
